name: RDD2020 — Road Damage Dataset (India, Japan, Czech Republic)
publisher: Arya et al. (University of Tokyo / sekilab) — released on Mendeley Data
role_summary: Indian road-damage visual evaluation (India subset) — earlier release; same VOC format as RDD2022; DIFFERENT, more restrictive licence reported.
version_note: Per search summaries (secondary): 26,336 images from India, Japan and the Czech Republic with >31,000 damage instances; four classes (D00 longitudinal crack, D10 transverse crack, D20 alligator crack, D40 pothole); subsets train / test1 / test2, each with India/Japan/Czech sub-directories of images and annotations; captured with vehicle-mounted smartphones. Version 1 published 2021-03-18.

data_access.kaggle: Process in place from /kaggle/input: attach a Kaggle Dataset holding the RDD2020 INDIA subset. Record the copy's provenance; the reported CC BY-NC 3.0 licence comes from a secondary source and is NOT verified.

license.name: Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported (CC BY-NC 3.0) for version 1 — per search summary of the Mendeley record; UNVERIFIED

evidence.source: web search summary of the Mendeley Data record
evidence.note: States version 1 is licensed Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported.
Official page could not be fetched: the authoring sandbox's network egress proxy blocks this host.

conflicts: RDD2022 (a different, later release of the same group) is reported as CC BY 4.0 / CC BY-SA 4.0. The two releases do NOT share a licence: never carry assumptions from one card to the other.
license.attribution: Cite the RDD2020 Data in Brief article and the Mendeley record (exact wording to be taken from the record).
license.commercial_use: NOT permitted if the NonCommercial licence is confirmed
notes: NonCommercial: if this licence is confirmed, use is limited to non-commercial research/education — decide whether that is compatible with CivicConnect's intended use BEFORE adopting it.

subset_used: India subset only (train split; test1/test2 are unannotated). Hold out by index block.
restrictions: Reported NonCommercial licence: do not use in any commercial product or service.
Do not commit images or annotations.

supports.how: Image-modality evaluation on Indian road damage: D40 → roads/pothole; cracks → category 'roads' only.
caveats: Smartphone road-survey frames, not citizen close-ups.
Frames from the same drive are near-identical: hold out whole index blocks, not random frames.

does_not_support.capability: Text, multilingual, severity, other civic categories

known_limitations: Three countries; India subset is the relevant slice.
privacy_notes: Images may contain people/vehicles; handle as external data.
expected_schema_notes: PASCAL VOC XML (same adapter as RDD2022). Directory layout reported as train/test1/test2 × India/Japan/Czech — confirm with `profile-images`.
citation: Arya, D., et al. (2021). RDD2020: An annotated image dataset for automatic road damage detection using deep learning. Data in Brief 36, 107133 (title/venue from search results; verify).
